title: pkg-guard configuration
description: Configuration for pkg-guard (pkg-guard.config.json or the "pkg-guard" key in package.json).

failOn.description: Block (exit code 1) when a vulnerability of this severity or higher is found. "none" never blocks on vulnerabilities.

production.description: Only check dependencies that ship with your app (ignore devDependencies).

strict.description: Exit with code 2 when a check cannot run (for example no internet). Recommended for CI.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time for each npm command, in milliseconds.

checks.description: Turn individual checks on or off.

fit.description: Hints about packages that Node.js now covers natively.

failOn.description: Block when a package is behind by at least this much. "never" only reports.

ignore.description: Package names (wildcard * allowed) that are never reported as outdated.

fail.description: Block when an unused dependency is found.

ignore.description: Package names (wildcard * allowed) that are never reported as unused.

sourceDirs.description: Folders that contain your source code. Empty means the whole project (without node_modules).

ignore.description: Vulnerabilities you have reviewed and accept. Every rule needs a reason.

advisory.description: Advisory id (GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx). Without it, all advisories of the package are ignored.

reason.description: Why it is safe to ignore.

expires.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which the rule stops applying.
